import json,http.client,pathlib,subprocess,sys
sha="96717c6cb95df40e0960e028601556080f8d0975"
token=(pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"tgtumbler"/"tumblr-operation-app"/"tumblr-app-access-token").read_text().strip()
def ck(name,condition):
 print(name+"="+("PASS" if condition else "FAIL"),flush=True)
 if not condition:sys.exit(42)
def get(path,auth=True):
 c=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
 try:
  c.request("GET",path,headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+token} if auth else {})
  r=c.getresponse()
  return r.status,r.read(2000000)
 finally:c.close()
checkout=subprocess.run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=8).stdout.strip()
ck("SOURCE_SHA",checkout==sha)
status,raw=get("/healthz")
ck("LIVE_SHA",status==200 and json.loads(raw).get("commit")==sha)
status,raw=get("/media/jobs?offset=0&limit=100")
data=json.loads(raw) if status==200 else {}
ck("HISTORY_PAGE_1",status==200 and data.get("verified") is True and isinstance(data.get("total"),int) and isinstance(data.get("has_next"),bool))
status2,raw2=get("/media/jobs?offset=100&limit=100")
data2=json.loads(raw2) if status2==200 else {}
ck("HISTORY_PAGE_2",status2==200 and data2.get("verified") is True and data2.get("offset")==100 and data2.get("total")==data.get("total"))
status,_=get("/media/jobs?offset=0&limit=100",auth=False)
ck("HISTORY_AUTH_401",status==401)
status,_=get("/media/jobs?offset=-1")
ck("HISTORY_QUERY_400",status==400)
status,js=get("/app.js")
ck("UI_HISTORY_AND_OWNER_PAGING",status==200 and b"mediaHistory(offset=0,oldPanel=null)" in js and b"references.slice(offset,offset+50)" in js and b'view.action==="tumblr.list_posts"' in js)
for suite in ("test_media_save.py","test_app_serve.py","test_operation_app.py","test_tumblr_read.py","test_library.py"):
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B","-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p",suite,"-q"],capture_output=True,timeout=45)
 ck("GSERVER_OFFLINE_"+suite,p.returncode==0)
print("REAL_PROVIDER_CALLS=ZERO")
print("ACCEPTANCE=PASS")
PY
